findings_deferred.title: 2026-06-08T04:35:00Z.json uses text fingerprints and non-hex finding IDs (pre-SHA256 era)
findings_deferred.detail: The 2026-06-08 scan file predates the SHA256-v1 fingerprint algorithm. Its three findings use human-readable text fingerprints ('audit-elevation-adr004-phase-c-stale-2026-06-08') and two finding IDs contain non-hex characters (f4g5h6i7, j8k9l0m1). Similarly, 20260604T050000Z.json and 20260624T000000Z.json use date-based non-SHA256 IDs (20260604-01, 20260624-01).
findings_deferred.fix_sketch: N/A — deferred as legacy. Pre-fingerprinting-era scan files are exempt from SHA256 ID/fingerprint conformance. Modifying historical IDs would invalidate any external references. These files are documented here for awareness.
findings_deferred.notes: by-design: scan files pre-dating the SHA256-v1 fingerprint algorithm retain their original IDs and fingerprint formats. The rubric.json fingerprint_algo applies to new findings going forward.
